Read a value from the disk cache, computing and storing it if absent

Source: R/binomial_pdccpp.R
disk_cached.Rd

Shares the binomial prior kernels between the worker processes of a run, and between runs: a kernel takes from seconds to minutes to compute and depends only on its key. Writes are atomic, so a process never reads a partly written file; two processes computing the same value at once both store the same result.

Usage

disk_cached(key, compute, subdirectory = "lattice_kernels")

Arguments

key

A list identifying the value.

compute

A function of no arguments returning the value.

subdirectory

Subdirectory of bexte_cache_dir().

Value

The value.
